en.hubeali: Ali Bin Muhammad and Muhammad Bin Abu Abdullah, from Is’haq Bin Muhammad Al Makhai’e who said, ‘Sufyan Bin Muhammad Al Zubayyi narrated to me saying,
‘I wrote to Abu Muhammad<sup>asws</sup> (11<sup>th</sup> Imam<sup>asws</sup>) asking him<sup>asws</sup> about the confidant, and these are the Words of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> the Exalted
[9:16] and do not take to any one besides Allah and His Rasool and the Believers as a confidant

, and I said to myself, ‘It is not in the Book. Where can you see a Believer over here?’ So the answer came back: ‘The confidant – is the one who is in the place of a Guardian<sup>asws</sup>. And I<sup>asws</sup> narrate to you about the Believers who are in this position, so they<sup>asws</sup> are the Imams<sup>asws</sup> who are believing in Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, so He<sup>azwj</sup> Authorises their<sup>asws</sup> safety’.
